messages.subject: Error in MRDS
parts:
Hi Eric,

I am using Distance 6.2, R 3.3.1, and MRDS package 2.1.14.  I keep getting an error when trying to run the MRDS engine in Distance.  I have been able to run the MRDS analyses within the past month without any trouble; however, I recently had my computer and programs updated and I started getting the error message in the snippet below.  I tried running projects and analyses that previously worked and I still get the same message.  Do you have any suggestions on how I should fix this?





Thanks!

Orrin

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Error in MRDS
parts:
Orrin

This is a problem associated with the installation of the R libraries on your machine into a directory "protected" by the Windows 7 operating system.  Hence the "directory not writeable" message generated by R.

The solution to this problem is described on the distancesampling.org website under "Installation of R for use with Distance 6.2"  at this link

http://distancesampling.org/Distance/old-versions/d62-r-install-details.html
